decisions.auth_method: User chon 2026-10-02: BO Google OAuth, chi dung Email OTP 6 số qua SMTP cho ca bootstrap, Quen mat khau va Doi key admin. Ly do: OTP gui vao dung hop thu da chung minh so huu email; khong can Google Cloud Console/OAuth client/consent screen; giam 1 diem hong cau hinh. Hau qua design: §4.2/§4.4 doi tu Google OAuth -> OTP email (da ghi).
decisions.p3t1_disable_signup: Chot 2026-10-02: disable_signup giu FALSE den khi bootstrap xong, sau do EF bootstrap-admin (P3-T2) tu dat true. Ly do (docs GoTrue): khi disable_signup=true chi con invite tao user duoc -> bat som se chan luong tao user moi (ca OAuth lan OTP) nen se chan luong bootstrap admin neu bat som. Khoan nay chong lai bang bootstrap-admin EF kiem tra bootstrapped=false + email trung secret (design §4.2 buoc 2) + khong cho dang ky tu do tren UI (P3-T3 chi hien khi bootstrapped=false).
decisions.p3t2_test_target: Chot 2026-10-02: test EF/DB tren CLOUD (dev) thay local stack — supabase start khong chay duoc tren may nay (Docker nested, iptables legacy/nft conflict -> packet container-to-container bi drop, trung B-001 P0-T6). Cloud API luon song: db query --linked, db push, db advisors, functions deploy --use-api, secrets set. Sau moi lan test bootstrap cloud phai RESET (xoa user+profile, bootstrapped=false, admin_email=null, disable_signup=false) de P3-T3/T9 chay lai duoc.
decisions.p3t2_ef_secrets: Chot 2026-10-02: EF bootstrap-admin dung 3 secrets: BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL, MGMT_ACCESS_TOKEN (PAT — EF tu PATCH disable_signup=true sau khi bootstrap, theo design §4.2.5 + decisions.p3t1_disable_signup), HEMTRA_PROJECT_REF (ten SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF bi tu choi — reserved prefix SUPABASE_). PAT trong EF secrets: ruyi ro neu EF bi exploit — chan bang verify_jwt=false + bootstrapped guard + email secret + OTP server-side; chi 1 endpoint duoc PATCH auth config.
decisions.p3t2_admin_auth_email: Chot 2026-10-02: admin GIU email that trong auth.users (khong doi sang <username>@hem.local nhu staff). Ly do: recovery/doi key (P3-T6/P3-T8) gui OTP den email that qua signInWithOtp — neu doi email thi GoTrue khong tim duoc user. Hau qua cho P3-T4 (auth-login EF): username->email mapping phac doan ...@hem.local dung cho staff; admin phai tra app_meta.admin_email (role=admin).
decisions.turnstile: User chon 2026-10-02: BO Turnstile khoi T4 + design (ly do: dung ca nhan, khong can phuc tap; chua co turnstile key). Lockout 5/15 phut van giu. Cap nhat design.md (§2/§4.3/§8.6), plan.md (P3-T4, P10-T5), auth/skill.md, security/skill.md.
decisions.lockout_otp_unlock: User chon 2026-10-02: sau 5 lan sai (khoa 5/15 phut username+IP) thi UI TU DONG de nghi gui OTP ve email de khoi phuc luot dang nhap (xoa bo dem) — thay cho Turnstile. GoTrue rate limit OTP + anti-oracle (response luon generic). Staff @hem.local khong nhan duoc mail -> doi 15 phut/lien he admin (nhan generic).
decisions.session_7d_note: User nhan manh 2026-10-02: can reset session sau 7 ngay -> phai login lai — day chinh la P3-T5 (client login_at + session_fresh() server da co tu P1), lam ngay sau T4.
